d: SAJA Pharmaceuticals is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Organizational Development & Talent Management Officer to join our Human Resources team.

q: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
1–3 years of relevant experience in HR, Organizational Development, Talent Management, or Learning & Development.
Good understanding of HR processes and performance management practices.
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Excellent communication, organization, and interpersonal skills.

Develop effective hiring strategies to attract and retain top talent.
Partner with department heads to identify workforce needs and hiring priorities.
Support HR operations, employee engagement, and performance management.
Drive talent development and contribute to a positive workplace culture.
Ensure HR policies and practices align with company objectives.
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in talent acquisition and/or HR operations.
Strong recruitment, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Good understanding of HR practices, employment regulations, and talent management.
Proactive, organized, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
